description: Backend OG-image + share-HTML endpoints and the CDK infra to serve them. Add two new Node 20 Lambdas: GET /og (returns the per-series OGP image as image/svg+xml, generated via the shared buildOgImageSvg) and GET /share (returns the crawler-readable HTML via the shared buildShareHtml). Both resolve the series from the existing BracketService (same bracket cache + MLB/seed fallback), cache the generated bytes in DynamoDB keyed by seriesId+situation+lang (like the prediction cache), carry only TABLE_NAME (NO Bedrock), and are added to the HTTP API. CloudFront routes /og and /share to the API so crawlers hitting a share URL get the meta tags while normal SPA navigation is unaffected. Update infra/test/stack.test.ts.
steps: Add query parsing for the share/og endpoints to backend/src/handlers/http.ts (or a small helper): parse `seriesId` (non-empty string, else 400), reuse parseSeason and parseLanguage. Add a non-JSON response helper, e.g. `rawResponse(statusCode, body, contentType, extraHeaders?)` that sets Content-Type and CORS Allow-Origin '*' and a Cache-Control header, for returning SVG and HTML bodies.

Extend BracketService (backend/src/service/bracketService.ts) with a method to resolve a single series + its bracket for a season: reuse the existing getBracket path (cache-first, MLB fetch, seed fallback) and find the series by id; return { bracket, series } or undefined when not found. Keep it dependency-injected/mockable like the other service methods.

Add OG-image caching to the store. In backend/src/store/dynamo.ts add `getCachedOgImage(cacheKey)` / `putCachedOgImage(cacheKey, svg, ttlSeconds)` to the BracketStore interface and DynamoBracketStore, keyed by `pk = cacheKey` (an OG#... string), storing the SVG string under an `svg` attribute with numeric ttl; no-op/undefined when TABLE_NAME unset. Add an `OG_IMAGE_TTL_SECONDS` (15 min) constant. Add a pure cache-key builder (e.g. backend/src/service/ogCacheKey.ts) `ogCacheKey({ seriesId, highWins, lowWins, lang })` -> `OG#<seriesId>#<highWins>-<lowWins>#<lang>` mirroring predictionCacheKey, with a colocated test. Reuse the same key for the share-HTML cache or key share-HTML separately with a SHARE# prefix (document choice).

Create backend/src/handlers/getOgImage.ts: GET /og?season=&seriesId=&lang=. Validate seriesId (400 if missing). Resolve the series via BracketService; if not found return a 404 (or a minimal placeholder SVG at 200 - choose and document, prefer 404 JSON for an unknown series). On success: build the OG cache key from series situation+lang, try getCachedOgImage; on hit return the cached SVG; on miss call shared buildOgImageSvg, putCachedOgImage, and return it. Respond image/svg+xml with Cache-Control (e.g. public, max-age=900). No Bedrock. Add backend/src/handlers/getOgImage.test.ts with the store + service mocked: cache hit returns stored SVG without rebuilding, cache miss builds+stores, content-type is image/svg+xml, the disclaimer substring is present in the body, a missing seriesId is 400, an unknown series is handled per the chosen contract.

Create backend/src/handlers/getShareHtml.ts: GET /share?season=&seriesId=&lang=. Resolve the series; build the og image URL and canonical permalink and the SPA app URL from the request (derive the public origin from event headers Host/X-Forwarded-* with a sane fallback, or from an env var SITE_ORIGIN injected by CDK; document the choice) and the shared buildShareHtml; cache the HTML (reuse the keyed cache) and return text/html at 200. Add backend/src/handlers/getShareHtml.test.ts (service mocked): returns text/html, body contains og:title/og:image/og:url and the localized disclaimer, redirects into the SPA route, 400 on missing seriesId, graceful handling of an unknown series.

Wire the new Lambdas into infra/lib/mlb-postseason-stack.ts following the getGameDetailFn template (NodejsFunction, Node 20, ESM, externalModules ['@aws-sdk/*'], memory 256, timeout 15, environment { TABLE_NAME } only - NO BEDROCK_MODEL_ID and NO bedrock policy). grantReadWriteData(table) to both. If SITE_ORIGIN is used, pass the CloudFront domain (or a token) as an env var. Add HTTP API routes GET /og and GET /share with HttpLambdaIntegration.

Route /og and /share through CloudFront to the HTTP API so a crawler hitting the share URL on the site origin reaches the Lambda (not the SPA shell). Add an additional CloudFront behavior for path patterns `/og` (and `/og/*` if needed) and `/share` (+`/share/*`) with an HttpOrigin pointing at the HTTP API domain, forwarding query strings, a caching policy that respects the query string, and viewer protocol redirect-to-https. Keep the default behavior (SPA) unchanged, and keep the 403/404->/index.html error responses (they only affect the S3 origin behavior). Document the routing decision (dedicated /share + /og paths, no UA sniffing) in a code comment.

Update infra/test/stack.test.ts: assert the template now has FIVE Lambda functions; assert exactly ONE function has a bedrock:InvokeModel IAM policy (still only GetPredictionFn) and that the new OG/share functions do NOT; assert the HTTP API has routes GET /og and GET /share; assert the CloudFront distribution has the additional behavior(s) for the /og and /share path patterns pointing at the API origin; keep the existing throttling and 403/404 rewrite assertions passing.
Run `PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build && npm test && npm run synth` and confirm all pass (synth is a real check since infra changed).
Commit, e.g. `feat(issue-21): /og SVG + /share HTML Lambdas with DynamoDB cache and CloudFront routing (no Bedrock)`.
acceptance_criteria: GET /og returns image/svg+xml generated by the shared builder, cache-first (hit skips rebuild, miss builds+stores), with the localized disclaimer in the body; missing seriesId -> 400 (backend handler tests pass).
GET /share returns text/html with per-series og:title/og:description(incl. disclaimer)/og:image/og:url/twitter:* and redirects a human into the SPA route (backend handler tests pass).
The two new Lambdas carry only TABLE_NAME and have NO bedrock:InvokeModel policy; generated OG images are cached in DynamoDB keyed by seriesId+situation+lang.
infra/test/stack.test.ts asserts 5 functions, exactly one Bedrock policy, GET /og + GET /share routes, and CloudFront /og + /share behaviors to the API origin - and passes.
`npm run build`, `npm test`, and `npm run synth` all pass with no AWS calls.
findings: Repo path is /projects/sandbox/kiro-mlb-postseason (NOT nested). Added rawResponse(statusCode,body,contentType,extraHeaders?) + SHARE_CACHE_CONTROL ('public, max-age=900') + parseSeriesId to http.ts. BracketService.getSeriesWithBracket(seriesId,season) reuses getBracket + the existing tolerant resolveSeries, returns {bracket,series}|undefined. dynamo.ts: added getCachedOgImage/putCachedOgImage (payload under 'svg' attr, numeric ttl, no-op when TABLE_NAME unset) + OG_IMAGE_TTL_SECONDS (15 min) on the BracketStore interface + DynamoBracketStore. Pure ogCacheKey.ts exports ogCacheKey() -> 'OG#<seriesId>#<highWins>-<lowWins>#<lang>' AND shareCacheKey() -> same with 'SHARE#' prefix (share HTML reuses the SAME getCachedOgImage/putCachedOgImage getter/putter under the SHARE# key, documented in both files); colocated ogCacheKey.test.ts. getOgImage.ts: 400 missing seriesId, 404 JSON unknown series (documented contract), cache-first image/svg+xml via shared buildOgImageSvg, disclaimer comes from the SVG builder. getShareHtml.ts: 400/404 same, text/html via shared buildShareHtml; public origin derived from forwarded headers X-Forwarded-Proto+Host with SITE_ORIGIN env override + localhost fallback (NOT injected from CDK - see infra note). Handler tests mock BracketService + DynamoBracketStore modules (vi.mock) following getPrediction/getGameDetail patterns: assert cache-hit returns stored bytes w/o rebuild, miss builds+stores, content-type, disclaimer substring (en+ja), 400, 404, and og:title/og:image/og:url + SPA redirect for /share. Infra: GetOgImageFn + GetShareHtmlFn (Node20 ESM, externalModules ['@aws-sdk/*'], 256MB/15s, env TABLE_NAME only, NO BEDROCK_MODEL_ID/no bedrock policy), grantReadWriteData both, GET /og + GET /share routes, CloudFront behaviors for /og,/og/*,/share,/share/* -> HttpOrigin(apiDomain via Fn.select/Fn.split) with a query-string-keyed CachePolicy (ShareApiCachePolicy) + redirect-to-https (dedicated paths, no UA sniffing, documented). IMPORTANT deviation: had to break a CloudFront<->API cyclic dependency - (1) HTTP API CORS allowOrigins changed from the specific CloudFront domain to ['*'] (every handler already emits Access-Control-Allow-Origin '*'); (2) did NOT inject SITE_ORIGIN env onto the share Lambda (would close a CloudFront<->Lambda cycle), handler derives origin from request headers instead. Both documented in stack comments. stack.test.ts: asserts FIVE nodejs20.x TABLE_NAME functions, EXACTLY ONE bedrock:InvokeModel policy (resourcePropertiesCountIs=1), GET /og + GET /share routes, CloudFront /og,/og/*,/share,/share/* behaviors + the https-only custom (HTTP API) origin; existing 403/404 + throttling (20/40) + single BucketDeployment assertions kept. Updated .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements(Requirement 21),design,tasks} + README.md + README.ja.md. Full build+test+synth all green (shared 62, backend 149, frontend 194, infra 13); only the pre-existing non-fatal nodejs20.x deprecation WARNINGs during synth/stack test.
